name: Claude PR Review and Issue Management

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths-ignore:
      - '.github/**'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'CONTRIBUTING.md'
      - 'LICENSE'
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
    # Only trigger on comments that are NOT from the bot itself
    # This prevents infinite loops
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  pr-review:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        run: |
          git fetch origin ${{ github.base_ref }}
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only origin/${{ github.base_ref }}...HEAD | grep -E '\.(ipynb|py|md|txt|yml|yaml)$' || echo "")
          
          if [ -z "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
            echo "No relevant files changed"
            echo "has_files=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Changed files:"
            echo "$CHANGED_FILES"
            echo "$CHANGED_FILES" > changed_files.txt
            echo "has_files=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run Claude PR Review
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.has_files == 'true'
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          prompt: "/review-pr"
          claude_args: |
            --allowedTools "Bash(gh pr comment:*),Bash(gh pr diff:*),Bash(gh pr view:*),Bash(echo:*),Read,Glob,Grep,WebFetch"

  issue-management:
    if: github.event_name == 'issues' || (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.comment.body == '/review-issue')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Process Issue with Claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          prompt: "/review-issue ${{ github.event.issue.number }}"
          claude_args: |
            --allowedTools "Bash(gh issue comment:*),Bash(gh issue view:*),Bash(gh issue close:*),Bash(gh issue label:*),Read,Glob,Grep,WebFetch"
